subs.text: Graham, I built this for you. 60 seconds, then delete this if it's not for you.
That finish line in the hero? That's yours. Every image on this site is from your Instagram.
This isn't a website — it's what your Instagram should have been building towards all along.
Your words. Your philosophy. Not marketing copy — the actual quote from your 114K post.
Coaching applications come through here. Not a Linktree link, not a DM.
ELATION COACH on your chest, your gym behind you. This is the first thing they see.
Every station photo is you. Your sled push, your rowing, your burpees. Not stock.
Your SkiErg through the flywheel. Your farmers carry. Your lunges with the ELATION tattoo showing.
Split analyser. They paste a result, see exactly where to improve.
That's you face-down on the arena floor. You gave everything. Now the data tells them why.
Instant breakdown. Every station benchmarked. Under your brand.
Race calculator. Your 54:42 on the board — they set their target, it tells them what each station needs to be.
Race-mate finder. You and Hannah running together is the hero image here.
Doubles partners pair up on your site, not in your DMs. No admin for you.
Results board. You and Hannah, 1:00:41. That's not a stock photo — that's your actual PB board.
Instagram is disposable. Stories vanish, posts get buried. This is permanent.
Your photography, your philosophy, your race tools, your coaching — under your name, on your domain.
Have a look around. I'd love to hear what you think.
